title: Advaitamakaranda
subtitle: Nectar of Non-duality

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
कटाक्षकिरणाचान्तनमन्मोहाब्धये नमः ।
अनन्तानन्दकृष्णाय जगन्मङ्गलमूर्तये ॥1॥
units.translation: Salutation to Krishna, whose bliss is boundless and whose form blesses the world; the rays of his glance drink up the ocean of delusion in those who bow.

gloss.en: drunk dry by the rays of a glance
for the ocean of delusion of those who bow
to Krishna, whose bliss is boundless
to the auspicious form that blesses the world

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
अहमस्मि सदा भामि कदाचिन्नाहमप्रियः ।
ब्रह्मैवाऽहमतः सिद्धं सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणम् ॥2॥
units.translation: I always exist and shine; I am never unwelcome. Therefore I am Brahman itself, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss.

gloss.en: defined by being, consciousness, and bliss

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
मय्येवोदेति चिद्व्योम्नि जगद्गन्धर्वपत्तनम् ।
अतोऽहं न कथं ब्रह्म सर्वज्ञं सर्वकारणम् ॥3॥
units.translation: The world, a phantom city in the sky, arises in me alone, the sky of consciousness. How, then, am I not Brahman, all-knowing and the cause of all?

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
न स्वतः प्रत्यभिज्ञानान्निरंशत्वान्न चान्यतः ।
न चाश्रयविनाशान्मे विनाशः स्यादनाश्रयात् ॥4॥
units.translation: I cannot be destroyed by myself, since I recognize my continuity; nor by another, since I am partless; nor by the destruction of a support, for I depend on none.

gloss.en: nor by destruction of a support

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
न शोषप्लोषविक्लेदच्छेदाश्चिन्नभसो मम ।
सत्यैरप्यनिलाग्न्यम्भः शस्त्रैः किमुत कल्पितैः ॥5॥
units.translation: The sky of consciousness that I am cannot be dried, burned, soaked, or cut by real wind, fire, water, or weapons—how much less by imagined ones.

gloss.en: no drying, burning, soaking, or cutting
of me, the sky of consciousness
how much less by imagined ones

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
आभारूपस्य विश्वस्य भानं भासन्निधेर्विना ।
कदाचिन्नावकल्पेत भा चाहं तेन सर्वगः ॥6॥
units.translation: This world of appearances could never shine without the presence of my light; and since I am that light, I am all-pervading.

gloss.en: of the world whose nature is appearance

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
न हि भानादृते सत्त्वं नर्ते भानं चितोऽचितः ।
चित्सम्भेदोऽपि नाध्यासादृते तेनाहमद्वयः ॥7॥
units.translation: Nothing exists apart from manifestation, and the inert cannot shine apart from consciousness. Even their apparent connection comes only from superimposition; therefore I am nondual.

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
न देहो नेन्द्रियं चाहं न प्राणो न मनो न धीः ।
ममतापरिरब्धत्वादाक्रीडत्वादिदं धियः ॥8॥
units.translation: I am not the body, the senses, the vital force, the mind, or the intellect: they are held as “mine” and serve as objects in which the intellect plays.

gloss.en: and I am not the vital force
not the mind, not the intellect
because they are embraced by the notion “mine”

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
साक्षी सर्वान्वितः प्रेयानहं नाहं कदाचन ।
परिणामपरिच्छेदपरितापैरुपप्लवात् ॥9॥
units.translation: I am the witness, present in all, and most dear; I am never the ego, which is beset by change, limitation, and suffering.

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
सुप्तेऽहमि न दृश्यन्ते दुःखदोषप्रवृत्तयः ।
अतस्तस्यैव संसारो न मे संसर्तृसाक्षिणः ॥10॥
units.translation: When the ego is asleep, suffering, faults, and their activities are not seen. Saṃsāra belongs to that ego alone, not to me, its witnessing awareness.

gloss.en: the witness of the one who transmigrates

units.label: Verse 11
units.deva:
सुप्तः सुप्तिं न जनाति नाऽसुप्ते स्वप्नजागरौ ।
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तीनां साक्ष्यतोऽहमतदृशः ॥11॥
units.translation: In deep sleep, the sleeper does not know sleep; when not asleep, dream and waking are absent. Since I witness waking, dream, and deep sleep, I am distinct from all three.

gloss.en: of waking, dream, and deep sleep
I am of a different nature

units.label: Verse 12
units.deva:
विज्ञानविरतिः सुप्तिस्तज्जन्म स्वप्नजागरौ ।
तत्साक्षिणः कथं मे स्युर्नित्यज्ञानस्य ते त्रयः ॥12॥
units.translation: Sleep is the cessation of specific cognition; dream and waking are its arising. How could those three states belong to me, the witness whose awareness is eternal?

units.label: Verse 13
units.deva:
षड्विकारवतां वेत्ता निर्विकारोऽहमन्यथा ।
तद्विकारानुसन्धानं सर्वथा नावकल्पते ॥13॥
units.translation: I know things subject to six changes; I am therefore changeless. Otherwise, no awareness of their changes could ever be possible.

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
तेन तेन हि रूपेण जायते लीयते मुहुः ।
विकारि वस्तु तस्यैषामनुसन्धातृता कुतः ॥14॥
units.translation: A changing thing is born and dissolves again and again in each successive form. How could it be the knower that traces all those changes?

gloss.en: how could there be the knowing continuity?

units.label: Verse 15
units.deva:
न च स्वजन्म नाशं वा द्रष्टुमर्हति कश्चन ।
तौ हि प्रागुत्तराभावचरमप्रथमक्षणौ ॥15॥
units.translation: No one can witness their own birth or death, for these are respectively the first moment after prior nonexistence and the last before what follows is absent.

units.label: Verse 16
units.deva:
न प्रकाशेऽहमित्युक्तिर्यत्प्रकाशैकबन्धना ।
स्वप्रकाशं तमात्मानमप्रकाशः कथं स्पृशेत् ॥16॥
units.translation: The statement “I do not shine” depends wholly on light. How could darkness touch the Self, which is self-luminous?

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
तथाप्याभाति कोऽप्येष विचाराभावजीवनः ।
अवश्यायश्चिदाकाशे विचारार्कोदयावधिः ॥17॥
units.translation: Even so, a certain mist appears in the sky of consciousness, sustained by lack of inquiry; it lasts only until the sun of inquiry rises.

gloss.en: lasting until the sun of inquiry rises

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
आत्माज्ञानमहानिद्राजृम्भितेऽस्मिन् जगन्मये ।
दीर्घस्वप्ने स्फुरन्त्येते स्वर्गमोक्षादिविभ्रमाः ॥18॥
units.translation: In this world-dream, expanded by the great sleep of ignorance of the Self, such appearances as heaven and liberation shine.

gloss.en: the great sleep of ignorance of the Self
appearances such as heaven and liberation

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
जडाजडविभागोऽयमजडे मयि कल्पितः ।
भित्तिभागे समे चित्रचराचरविभागवत् ॥19॥
units.translation: This division between inert and conscious is imagined in me, who am never inert, as figures of moving and unmoving things are divided on a single flat wall.

gloss.en: this distinction between inert and conscious
in me, who am not inert
like the division of moving and unmoving figures in a picture

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
चेत्योपरागरूपा मे साक्षितापि न तात्त्विकी ।
उपलक्षणमेवेयं निस्तरङ्गचिदम्बुधेः ॥20॥
units.translation: Even my witnesshood, shaped by association with what is known, is not ultimately real; it merely indicates the wave-free ocean of consciousness.

gloss.en: taking form through association with the known
of the wave-free ocean of consciousness

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
अमृताब्धेर्न मे जीर्णिर्मृषा डिण्डीरजन्मभिः ।
स्फटिकार्द्रो मे रागः स्वाप्नसंध्याभ्रविभ्रमैः ॥21॥
units.translation: The ocean of immortality that I am is not diminished by the false birth of foam; dreamlike twilight-cloud illusions do not stain me, clear as crystal.

gloss.en: through the false birth of foam

units.label: Verse 22
units.deva:
स्वरूपमेव मे सत्त्वं न तु धर्मो नभस्त्ववत् ।
मदन्यस्य सतोऽभावान्न हि सा जातिरिष्यते ॥22॥
units.translation: Existence is my very nature, not an attribute such as “being sky.” Since no existent thing is other than me, existence is not a separate class inhering in me.

gloss.en: because no existent thing is other than me
that universal class is not accepted

units.label: Verse 23
units.deva:
स्वरूपमेव मे ज्ञानं न गुणः स गुणो यदि ।
अनात्मत्वमसत्त्वं वा ज्ञेयाज्ञेयत्वयोः पतेत् ॥23॥
units.translation: Consciousness is my very nature, not a quality. If it were a quality, I would be either non-self as something knowable, or nonexistent as something unknowable.

gloss.en: in the alternatives of being knowable or unknowable

units.label: Verse 24
units.deva:
अहमेव सुखं नान्यदन्यच्चेन्नैव तत् सुखम् ।
अमदर्थं न हि प्रेयो मदर्थं न स्वतः प्रियम् ॥24॥
units.translation: I alone am happiness; nothing else is. If something were other than me, it could not be happiness: nothing is dear apart from me, and nothing is dear in itself.

units.label: Verse 25
units.deva:
न हि नानास्वरूपं स्यादेकं वस्तु कदाचन ।
तस्मादखण्ड एवास्मि विजहज्जागतीं भिदाम् ॥25॥
units.translation: A single reality can never have many natures. Therefore I am indivisible, having left behind the distinctions of the world.

units.label: Verse 26
units.deva:
परोक्षतापरिच्छेदशाबल्यापोहनिर्मलम् ।
तदसीति गिरा लक्ष्यमहमेकरसं महः ॥26॥
units.translation: The radiant, undivided essence indicated by “That thou art” is me, purified of indirectness, finitude, and the defects that obscure identity.

units.label: Verse 27
units.deva:
उपशान्तजगज्जीवशिष्याचार्येश्वरभ्रमम् ।
स्वतः सिद्धमनाद्यन्तं परिपूर्णमहं महः ॥27॥
units.translation: I am the self-established, beginningless, endless, all-complete radiance in which the mistaken notions of world, individual, student, teacher, and Lord have come to rest.

gloss.en: the mistaken notions of world, individual, student, teacher, and Lord

units.label: Verse 28
units.deva:
लक्ष्मीधरकवेः सूक्तिशरदम्भोजसम्भृतः ।
अद्वैतमकरन्दोऽयं विद्वद्भृङ्गैर्निपीयताम् ॥28॥
units.translation: May this Advaita Makaranda, gathered from the autumn-lotus sayings of the poet Lakṣmīdhara, be sipped by the bees that are the wise.

gloss.en: gathered from the autumn lotuses of sayings
by the bees that are the wise
